content.title: 'The Boys' Season 5: Cast, Release Date, Storylines & How to Watch the Final Season
content.text: It all ends here. After five seasons of shocking twists, bold storytelling and unforgettable characters, The Boys returns for its final chapter on Prime Video starting April 8, 2026. Showrunner Eric Kripke has teased a finale that’s “gory, epic, and emotionally devastating” — and if the series has proven anything, it’s that nothing is off limits. Across four seasons, The Boys has flipped the superhero genre on its head, blending dark humor with explosive, unpredictable storytelling. Season 5 begins in a world that’s been completely reshaped; Homelander holds more power than ever, The Boys are fractured and the fight against Vought is reaching its breaking point. For DIRECTV customers, The Boys is available on Prime Video through DIRECTV, making it easy to watch alongside your favorite live TV and streaming content all in one place. Watch ‘The Boys’ Season 5 on Prime Video Through DIRECTV! ‘The Boys’ Season 5: Quick Facts Premiere Date: April 8, 2026 Episodes: 8 Release Schedule: Weekly (Wednesdays) Streaming On: Prime Video Final Season: Yes ‘The Boys’ Season 5 Release Date & Episode Schedule The Boys Season 5 premieres April 8, 2026, with two episodes released at launch. New episodes drop every Wednesday leading up to the series finale on May 20, 2026. Full episode schedule: Episode 1: “Fifteen Inches of Sheer Dynamite” — April 8 Episode 2: — April 8 Episode 3: — April 15 Episode 4: — April 22 Episode 5: — April 29 Episode 6: — May 6 Episode 7: — May 13 Episode 8: (Series Finale) — May 20 What to Remember Before Watching Season 5 Four seasons have built a complex, high-stakes world. Here’s a quick refresher before the final chapter begins: ‘The Boys’ Season 1 After a personal tragedy involving A-Train, Hughie Campbell joins Billy Butcher and The Boys, a group determined to expose the truth about Vought and its superheroes. Homelander quickly emerges as far more dangerous than he appears. ‘The Boys’ Season 2 Butcher discovers his wife Becca is alive and raising Homelander’s son, Ryan. Meanwhile, Stormfront joins The Seven, bringing new power (and a dangerous hidden past) into the spotlight. ‘The Boys’ Season 3 Butcher and Hughie use a temporary version of Compound V, blurring the line between heroes and the people they’re fighting. The return of Soldier Boy introduces a powerful new threat with deep ties to Homelander. ‘The Boys’ Season 4 Homelander tightens his grip on power while Butcher faces the consequences of Temp V. Ryan’s loyalties begin to shift, and the divide between The Boys grows deeper than ever. What to Expect in ‘The Boys’ Season 5 Season 5 opens with the world firmly under Homelander’s control. Hughie, Mother’s Milk and Frenchie are captured, while Starlight leads a resistance effort against overwhelming odds. Kimiko’s fate remains uncertain, and the team is more divided than ever. Billy Butcher returns with a dangerous new plan: a virus capable of wiping out all Supes. Whether he can be trusted to use it responsibly may be the biggest question of the final season. Cast members have hinted that the ending won’t follow a traditional path. Expect major character moments, unexpected turns and a finale that fans will be talking about long after it airs. One of the most talked-about additions is a Supernatural reunion. Jensen Ackles is joined by Jared Padalecki and Misha Collins in Episode 5, bringing together familiar faces in entirely new (and unpredictable) roles. Returning cast: Karl Urban as Billy Butcher Antony Starr as Homelander Jack Quaid as Hughie Campbell Erin Moriarty as Annie January / Starlight Laz Alonso as Mother’s Milk Karen Fukuhara as Kimiko Tomer Capone as Frenchie Jensen Ackles as Soldier Boy Jessie T. Usher as A-Train Chace Crawford as The Deep Jeffrey Dean Morgan as Joe Kessler New additions: Jared Padalecki — Episode 5 (role TBA) Misha Collins — Episode 5 (role TBA) Daveed Diggs as Oh-Father How to Watch ‘The Boys’ Season 5 on DIRECTV The Boys Season 5 streams exclusively on Prime Video, with new episodes arriving every Wednesday from April 8 through May 20.
